She is dressed in a school-themed outfit consisting of a white long-sleeved sweater, a blue collared shirt with a red tie, and a bright blue pleated skirt. Her hands move with extreme dexterity across the piano keys, which reflect the studio lights. The background consists of vertical blue-lit acoustic curtains providing a professional studio setting. The pianist in the bottom section continues her performance with high focus, her body swaying slightly with the rhythm of the music. She maintains a consistent posture, seated on a black leather piano bench, until she reaches the final chords of the composition. The video concludes with her finishing the piece in the same studio environment.
